component.name: nibwarden
component.summary: Your Bitwarden vault on the desktop
在桌面使用你的 Bitwarden 密碼庫
在桌面使用你的 Bitwarden 密码库

description.p: nibwarden keeps a Bitwarden or Vaultwarden vault unlocked for your desktop session and asks before programs use it.

ul.li: Browse, search and edit the vault, and copy from quick access with the keyboard
An SSH agent with the vault's keys; git commits signed with them
Secrets for scripts and the command line, approved in a window
Locks when idle, when the screen locks and before suspend
Unlocks the official Bitwarden browser extension
